rulings.Case Title: IN THE MATTER OF THE JAMESON MARK SPECIAL NEEDS TRUST
rulings.Calendar Matter: ACCOUNTING PETITION RE: Accounting #1, Report
rulings.Rulings: Continued to 10/20/2026. Issues necessitating continuance: 1) No notice of hearing has been filed with court. Form DE-120 is the mandatory judicial council form for this petition. 2) The instant petition states that petitioner "does not by this filing seek the settlement, allowance, or approval of the account or of her acts, and asks only that the Court receive the accompanying account and this Report in advance of the hearing set for July 14, 2026." The trust instrument, specifically Article Eight, Section 4, requires the trustee to file accounts and reports for court approval. Please provide authority for petitioner to present the accounting in this way, which appears to be at odds with the trust's provisions. 3) A petition and account involving a trust must state the names and last known addresses of all vested or contingent beneficiaries (CRC 7.902). 3) For trusts funded by Court order, as defined by CRC 7.903(a), for the first account, all fiduciaries must also file original account statements showing the account balance on the date immediately preceding the date the fiduciary was appointed. The ending balance of cash assets must be verified. Verification is made by original bank or brokerage statements or original bank letters signed by a bank officer with the authority to sign, showing the vesting of the account, the date, and the amount of the balance. The statements or letters must encompass, not precede, the ending date of the accounting period (LRSF 14.34.D). 4) No proposed order has been received or reviewed by the court (LRSF 14.7.A). Please address the above issues and deliver courtesy copies of all further filings to this examiner no later than 10/06/2026 to avoid additional continuance.

rulings.Case Title: CONSERVATORSHIP OF FRANCO MENDOZA
rulings.Calendar Matter: ACCOUNTING PETITION RE: Accounting #1, Report, Fees
rulings.Rulings: Continued to 10/14/2. (No earlier availability.) Issue(s) necessitating continuance: (1) Why was the additional accounting for such an extended period of time (ending 3/20/26), when the conservator no longer had access to the accounts and the administrator was appointed on 12/3/25? (2) Why did the conservator make funeral arrangements, etc., when the conservatee was survived by a daughter? (3) Many of the time entries in the conservator's fee declaration filed on 6/29/26 for services of the estate were not in chronological order, so they have not yet been fully reviewed. (4) A courtesy copy of the financial statements was not received by the examiner, but it appears that no First Citizens statement for the period ending 8/17/25 was filed. The ending balance in the accounting is not verified by any bank statement. (5) The attorney costs do not reflect when such costs were actually incurred. At least one entry on 7/1/25 for filing the second confidential capacity assessment appears to have been duplicated. (6) None of the pleadings appears to include an amended prayer, only allegations. Please provide a revised proposed order and courtesy copies of any papers filed to address these issues to the assigned examiner by 9/30/26. Examiner continuances are final and not subject to contest under LRSF 14.10 B. (The petition was AMENDED by "supplements", which was still a mischaracterization even if copies of the supplements were mailed with the notice of hearing. Fees for supplementing a petition that should have been complete when filed are not reasonable. In order for this Court to track closed matters, orders to terminate a conservatorship must begin with the following language: "Order Terminating Conservatorship." [LRSF 14.47 F.3.e.])

rulings.Rulings: Continued to 10/06/2026. The following issues remained unaddressed: 1) Please explain why an estate this size ($0) requires administration. 2) Bond is required for out of state residents. A declaration setting forth in detail the anticipated liabilities of the decedent and claims against the estate is required to determine appropriate bond. All notices must include language about remote appearances (San Francisco Local Rule 14.1.C.6). Please address the above issues and deliver courtesy copies of all further filings to this examiner no later than 09/22/2026 to avoid additional continuance.
